office_does: The county clerk keeps the records and handles the funds of the Whitman County Superior Court.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Jill Whelchel, county clerk since 2015, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Whitman County Clerk since 2015; previously the county's staff guardian ad litem and CASA program manager. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Served as the county's staff guardian ad litem and CASA program manager from 2005 to 2014 [S1]
Says she will keep Superior Court records accurate and accessible to the public [S1]
